narrative: Scout's private preview is gated behind a GitHub Copilot license and the Dev Box ships Copilot pre-configured, so the Copilot entitlement stays the central wallet the prediction's margin logic rides on. But no artifact names a Microsoft first-party MAI model as Copilot's default completion or agent engine today, so the default-engine swap itself remains unproven.
remaining_gap: No changelog or pricing artifact names an MAI model as Copilot's default, and no per-model token rates separate a first-party default from a premium tier.
